basic_info.description: Lovingly maintained by the same family for generations, this residence features stunning original details, including beautifully preserved parquet hardwood floors with inlay and a vaulted ceiling. The kitchen features an eat-in breakfast nook that leads to the large formal dining room. Two bedrooms and one full bathroom complete the top floor. Downstairs, you'll find the third bedroom/bonus room and a half bath. The location is perfectly situated to enjoy expansive views of the Pacific Ocean and soak in sunsets. The oversized lot boasts a terraced yard with endless potential. A massive garage provides exciting expansion opportunities within the envelope, making this home as versatile as it is timeless.
